channels.name: Main Link (ML_Lane0..3 +/-)
channels.idle_level: blanking / idle symbols; quiescent during PSR

channels.name: AUX CH (AUX+/AUX-)
channels.purpose: DPCD (incl. eDP block) access / link training / I2C-over-AUX / backlight / PSR control.

channels.name: HPD
channels.active_levels: asserted while present; short pulse = IRQ_HPD

channels.name: BL_PWM / BL_EN
channels.purpose: Optional backlight PWM / enable when not fully AUX-controlled.

channels.name: VDD / VBL / GND
channels.purpose: Panel logic / backlight power and ground.

global_signals.name: AUX CH
global_signals.purpose: Bidirectional half-duplex management channel for the whole link (DPCD + eDP block / training / EDID / backlight / PSR).

handshake_pairs.name: AUX request/reply
handshake_pairs.rule: Half-duplex native/I2C AUX transaction; reply ACK/NACK/DEFER.

handshake_pairs.name: CR status
handshake_pairs.rule: CR_DONE per lane in LANE*_STATUS gates the EQ phase.

handshake_pairs.name: ADJUST_REQUEST
handshake_pairs.rule: Panel requests per-lane voltage swing / pre-emphasis.

handshake_pairs.name: HPD / IRQ_HPD
handshake_pairs.rule: Presence + event signaling triggering status re-read.

handshake_pairs.name: PSR entry/exit
handshake_pairs.rule: Source enables PSR / re-establishes the link; panel self-refreshes from the RFB.

dependency_graph.common_rule: The AUX channel must be operational first: the Source reads DPCD capability + eDP_CONFIGURATION_CAP and EDID, then trains the Main Link (Fast Link Training or full CR/EQ). The Main Link clock is embedded and recovered per lane during CR; multi-lane links are de-skewed during EQ. HPD gates the whole sequence (no HPD -> no link). PSR depends on a panel-local Remote Frame Buffer (RFB).
dependency_graph.data_dependency: Active video on the Main Link requires: (1) HPD asserted, (2) DPCD capability read, (3) panel power sequenced, (4) link trained. The pixel clock is regenerated from the MSA Mvid/Nvid; during PSR the panel refreshes from the RFB.

logical_signaling_levels.name: Active Main Link
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: Differential NRZ video micro-packets (8b/10b), embedded clock.

logical_signaling_levels.name: Main Link idle
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: Blanking/idle symbols; quiescent during PSR self-refresh.

logical_signaling_levels.name: AUX request
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: Manchester-II native/I2C request from the Source.

logical_signaling_levels.name: AUX reply
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: Manchester-II ACK/NACK/DEFER reply from the panel Sink.

ordering_rules.bit_order_on_wire: Differential NRZ per lane; 8b/10b 10-bit symbols; LFSR-scrambled (ASSR alternate seed when enabled); clock embedded.
ordering_rules.stream_order: Active video packed into Transfer Units, framed by BS/BE; MSA once per frame in vertical blanking.
ordering_rules.lane_striping: Pixel data striped across the active Main Link lanes (1/2/4); de-skewed during EQ.
ordering_rules.aux_order: Half-duplex: request then reply, one transaction at a time.
